A black-and-white CHILDREN'S COLORING BOOK page, square 1:1, 1080x1080.

SCENE: A friendly cartoon RHINOVIRUS character — the common-cold virus — sitting happily inside the cool front hallway of a giant cartoon NOSE shown in simple cut-away side view. The rhinovirus is a chunky round ball covered in bumpy faceted plates with little raised five-pointed star mounds and ring-shaped grooves around them (it has NO spikes and NO fuzzy coat). It has a BIG FRIENDLY FACE: two large round eyes with pupils, cheerful curved eyebrows and a wide happy grin, plus two little stubby arms waving. It wears a cosy knitted bobble hat and a striped scarf because it likes things chilly.
Around it in the same scene: two small smiling nose-lining cell characters with simple faces and a row of wavy hair-like cilia along their tops, standing on the floor of the nose passage; a big crumpled paper tissue; and, on the other side, a large chunky bar of SOAP with a pair of friendly cartoon HANDS scrubbing it, releasing a few big round outlined soap bubbles that drift toward the virus. Everything is drawn large, simple and chunky so a child can colour inside every shape.

STYLE — coloring book line art:
- BOLD, THICK, EVEN BLACK OUTLINES on pure WHITE. Every shape fully closed.
- ABSOLUTELY NO shading, NO grey tones, NO hatching, NO stippling, NO cross-hatching, NO gradients, NO colour fill, NO solid black areas anywhere (eyes may have a small solid pupil only).
- Simple, cheerful, chunky cartoon shapes with generous white space inside them.

STRICTLY FORBIDDEN — the page is rejected if any of these appear:
- ANY decorative STARBURST, comic-style radiating burst, "pow"/impact star, sparkle burst, twinkle burst, sunbeam rays, radiating speed lines or halo of rays behind, around or under the character. No radiating lines of any kind. They leave a big empty shape that cannot be removed afterwards.
- ANY rectangle, rounded rectangle, square box outline, picture frame, panel edge, comic panel, border line, outer margin line, ground-line box, or vignette. The drawing must NOT sit inside a box of any kind.
- The artwork must BLEED OFF ALL FOUR EDGES of the square — the nose passage, floor and background elements run right off the top, bottom, left and right edges with no white margin band and no enclosing outline.
- NO text, letters, numbers, words, captions, labels, signatures or watermarks anywhere.
- NO speech bubble, thought bubble or balloon of any kind (one is added separately afterwards).
- NO lipid envelope or membrane around the virus, NO spikes, NO tail, NO legs beyond the two little stubby arms.
